title: Build SCD Type 2 History from Snapshots
hints: Process snapshots in date order. For each customer keep the list of versions built so far; compare the incoming attributes with the latest version's attributes.
When attributes differ, close the open version (valid_to = this snapshot_date, is_current = False) and open a new one starting on this snapshot_date.
The tracked attributes are every column except snapshot_date and customer_id; compare them as a dict so the code works for any attribute set.
